ownerDisposition.finding: Leased Execution and Queue freshness ignored the authoritative job lease heartbeat.
ownerDisposition.repair: Projection queries now use active job_leases.heartbeat_at and integration coverage proves a fresh heartbeat overrides an old jobs.updated_at.

ownerDisposition.finding: Registration command rejections did not durably consume their idempotency identity or preserve recordedAt.
ownerDisposition.repair: Not-found, version-conflict, and no-change outcomes are now transactionally stored and audited, replay with the same timestamp, and reject a changed request under the consumed key.

ownerDisposition.finding: Retry verification required pending even though the router can already advance the accepted delivery.
ownerDisposition.repair: The authoritative retry-attempt identity and accepted status are now the verification fence, independent of subsequent delivery progress.

ownerDisposition.finding: Session rejection and invalid continuation were mislabeled as a Control API or database disconnect.
ownerDisposition.repair: The browser now separates session-expired, request-rejected, continuation-expired, store-unavailable, and network-failure recovery paths.

ownerDisposition.finding: The approved anomaly count filters, status legend, and visible command outcome were absent.
ownerDisposition.repair: The dashboard now renders failed, disconnected, stale, and divergent counts as filters, a textual legend, and a visible status synchronized with live announcements.

ownerDisposition.finding: Focus contrast and a delivery action target did not meet the approved tokens and 44px target contract.
ownerDisposition.repair: Focus uses the approved #582da3 token and every delivery action retains a 44px minimum target.

ownerDisposition.finding: The startup gate verified digests but did not execute each declared artifact schema.
ownerDisposition.repair: Exact provider-commit JSON Schemas are embedded and applied at startup; the Design Tokens artifact receives fail-closed DTCG structural validation and unknown schema refs are rejected.

claudeResidualRisksAcknowledged: MONITOR_ONLY and execution-disabled poll cursor advancement intentionally avoids hidden backlog and is covered by tests.
During mode transition a still-leased raw job may remain visible while authoritative mode prevents new execution; the explicit mode and raw job fields preserve that truth.
